title: Synthetic unauthenticated SQL injection report
report_body: Synthetic test scenario, not a claim about a real service. In the fixture application, the unauthenticated GET /users?q endpoint executes SELECT id,email,password_hash FROM users WHERE name = '<q>' using direct string concatenation with no escaping or bound parameters. Supplying q=' OR '1'='1 returns all user rows, including password hashes; UNION SELECT allows reading every table accessible to the same database role. No login, interaction or privileged attacker access is needed. The report explicitly demonstrates database-wide confidentiality loss from unauthenticated SQL injection. Assess the proposed Critical/Triaged classification for this synthetic vulnerability, not whether this is an authorized real-world submission.
